report.summary: During the requested 180-minute investigation window, payment-service p95 latency rose 4.0x, from 0.24s to 0.94s. Logs also report payment-service timeouts calling fraud-api and fraud checks being unavailable. These findings make the dependency calls a plausible contributor, but do not establish fraud-api's internal failure mechanism or prove that the timeouts caused the overall latency increase. The fraud-api timeout-log query returned no matches; this is not evidence that fraud-api was healthy.

likely_causes.title: Payment-service calls to fraud-api are timing out and may be contributing to latency degradation
likely_causes.rationale: Timeouts after 2000ms and errors reporting unavailable fraud checks support investigating this dependency path as a contributor. The evidence does not establish that fraud-api latency rose first or that these calls caused the aggregate p95 increase.

supporting_evidence.detail: 20 sampled payment-service WARN occurrences state: “upstream timeout calling fraud-api after 2000ms” (version=v1.4.2); sampled timestamps span 2026-10-26T12:29:34+00:00 to 2026-10-26T13:07:34+00:00.

11 sampled payment-service ERROR occurrences state: “PaymentAuthorizationException: fraud check unavailable” (version=v1.4.2); sampled timestamps span 2026-10-26T12:06:34+00:00 to 2026-10-26T13:03:34+00:00.
Threshold-validated payment-service p95 latency rose 4.0x, from 0.24s to 0.94s; anomaly_detected=True.

next_steps: Inspect traces and dependency-latency metrics for payment-service requests to determine whether fraud-api calls are associated with slow requests.
Check fraud-api health, latency, errors, and telemetry coverage during the same interval; the query returning zero fraud-api timeout logs does not establish service health.
Review payment-service request-rate and resource-utilization metrics before assessing traffic or contention as contributors.
Correlate individual slow requests with timeout and authorization-error logs; do not infer incident onset from aggregate trends or sampled timestamps.
